content.title: Deckers Third-Quarter Sales Rise on Demand for Hoka
content.summary: Demand for Hoka has climbed in the U.S. and internationally, Chief Executive  Stefano Caroti  said during a call with analysts.  Hoka sales jumped 19% in the quarter, pushing overall revenue up 7.1%.  Hoka has also been resonating with a wider range of consumers, including those looking for lifestyle apparel rather than just performance wear, and has had a growing international presence.

content.title: Deckers (DECK) Surpasses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
content.summary: Deckers (DECK) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +20.38% and +4.27%, respectively, for the quarter ended December 2025. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

content.title: Deckers (NYSE:DECK) Reports Strong Q4 CY2025, Stock Jumps 13.1%
content.summary: Footwear and apparel conglomerate Deckers (NYSE:DECK) reported Q4 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.1% year on year to $1.96 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $5.41 billion at the midpoint came in 0.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $3.33 per share was 20.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Deckers shares soar 15% as UGG and HOKA drive record Q3 earnings
content.summary: Investing.com -- Deckers Brands (NYSE: DECK) shares surged 15% after the footwear company reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results that significantly exceeded analyst expectations, driven by strong demand for its UGG and HOKA brands.

content.title: Deckers Racks Up Record Revenue in Q3 as ‘Significant Global Demand’ for Ugg and Hoka Continues
content.summary: Net sales in Q3 increased 7.1 percent to $1.96 billion compared to $1.83 billion the same time last year.

content.title: Deckers: Fiscal Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: On a per-share basis, the Goleta, California-based company said it had profit of $3.33. The results beat Wall Street expectations. The average estimate of eight analysts surveyed by Zacks Investment Research was for earnings of $2.77 per share.
